46603bfc00c3f681.description: Job description Assistant Manager – Engineering & Smart Asset Management Posting Date : 15/10/2026 Ref : ITKSA114 Position : Assistant Manager – Engineering & Smart Asset Management Location : KSA City : Riyadh Sector : Hospitality Years of Experience 5–7 years of engineering/facilities maintenance experience with at least 2 years in a supervisory role. Qualification : Bachelor’s degree in Mechatronics, Mechanical, Electrical, or Building Services Engineering. Salary : Commensurate with Experience Workdays : Description : Position Purpose: The Assistant Manager – Engineering & Smart Asset Management provides hands-on technical and supervisory leadership to ensure the reliable operation and maintenance of the Compound's buildings, infrastructure, utilities, and MEP systems. This role directly coordinates daily technical operations while actively supporting the transition toward preventive maintenance, CAFM/BMS-enabled operations, energy efficiency, and data-driven asset management. Key Responsibilities: Maintenance & Operations: Direct daily maintenance activities across MEP and civil infrastructure. Resolve work orders, monitor system performance, and reduce reactive failures through preventive maintenance schedules. Team Supervision: Supervise and deploy four technical teams ( Electrical, Civil, Mechanical, and General Maintenance ). Drive team productivity, workplace safety, discipline, and daily task quality. Smart Asset Management: Support CAFM and BMS implementation, maintain an accurate asset register, conduct condition assessments, and track technical data to optimize maintenance planning. Energy & Sustainability: Monitor utility consumption, execute water/energy efficiency initiatives, and assist with energy audit recommendations. Contractor & HSSE Oversight: Coordinate on-site contractors, inspect work quality, ensure strict adherence to HSSE requirements, and partner with the HSSE team to mitigate operational risks. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Preventive maintenance completion rate and response/resolution times Backlog reduction and minimization of recurring reactive failures Technical team productivity and work quality CAFM/BMS adoption and data accuracy Energy/water efficiency gains and HSSE compliance Candidate Qualifications & Requirements: Education & Experience: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechatronics, Mechanical, Electrical, or Building Services Engineering. Experience: 5–7 years of engineering/facilities maintenance experience with at least 2 years in a supervisory role . Preferred Background: Practical experience in residential compounds, hospitality, property management, or mixed-use facilities. Mechatronics background is a strong plus. Certifications: Professional engineering license, FM/Asset Management training, or energy management certifications are desirable. Technical Skills & Tools: Deep knowledge of MEP systems , HVAC, plumbing, and building infrastructure. Practical hands-on expertise with CAFM / CMMS and BMS / Building Automation . Familiarity with energy audits, contractor management, and data-driven/IoT maintenance practices. Competencies & Languages: Leadership & Communication: Strong people manager capable of leading multidisciplinary teams and communicating effectively with both executive staff and technical workers. Analytical Problem-Solving: Root-cause diagnostic mindset with an ability to translate technical issues into actionable solutions. Languages: Professional English required; Arabic preferred (for workforce and contractor coordination). Work Environment: Hands-on operational role requiring regular site presence across compound facilities, plant rooms, workshops, and outdoor infrastructure. Occasional availability outside normal working hours may be required for critical failures or emergencies. Compensation & Benefits: Competitive base salary with housing and transportation allowances/benefits. Comprehensive medical insurance, annual flight benefits, and annual leave in accordance with company policy and Saudi Labor Law. End-of-service benefits and opportunities for professional growth in smart building technologies and asset management. More Preferred candidate Years of experience 2+ years Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

469188098290ef6d.description: Job description The Fire Safety Engineer is responsible for delivering technical fire and life safety engineering activities across KAUST under the direction of the Fire Safety Engineering Lead. The role supports KAUST's delegated Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) governance framework by conducting technical reviews, field assessments, inspections, compliance verification, fire risk assessments, and technical investigations within approved KAUST procedures and delegated authorities. The role prepares technical recommendations for review and approval through the Lead, Fire Safety Engineer and the Health and Safety Manager, as applicable. The Fire Safety Engineer also supports compliance with Saudi Civil Defense requirements, Saudi Building Code (SBC), National Fire Protection Association (NFPA), International Fire Code (IFC), and KAUST requirements by maintaining audit-ready evidence, verifying fire protection system performance, supporting Civil Defense-related documentation and inspections where applicable, and escalating significant fire and life safety risks. Responsibilities Conduct fire and life safety engineering reviews, assessments, inspections, and field verifications. Review fire safety requirements for new construction, renovations, research facilities, high-hazard areas, and fire protection systems. Ensure compliance with SBC, NFPA, IFC, KAUST requirements, and Saudi Civil Defense requirements. Conduct fire risk assessments, inspections, system verification, and compliance checks, and recommend corrective actions. Review and maintain fire safety documentation, drawings, test certificates, inspection records, ITM records, and deficiency closure evidence. Coordinate with Projects, Facilities, contractors, consultants, Fire & Emergency Services, and other stakeholders to resolve fire safety issues. Provide technical assurance for Inspection, Testing & Maintenance (ITM) of fire protection systems and monitor corrective actions. Participate in testing, commissioning, acceptance, and functional verification of fire alarms, suppression systems, smoke control, passive fire protection, fire doors, barriers, and egress systems. Support investigations of fire incidents, unwanted alarms, system failures, and impairments, including root cause analysis and corrective actions. Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

46979b0a5fce6d07.description: Electrical Project Engineer Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Department: Projects & Real Estate Job Summary We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Electrical Project Engineer to oversee and coordinate electrical engineering activities across real estate development, construction, and facility improvement projects. The role involves ensuring that electrical installations and project deliverables are completed according to approved designs, technical specifications, project schedules, safety regulations, and quality standards. Key Responsibilities Supervise and coordinate electrical works across construction, real estate development, and renovation projects. Review electrical drawings, technical specifications, shop drawings, and material submittals to ensure compliance with project requirements. Monitor project progress and ensure electrical activities are completed within approved timelines, budgets, and quality standards. Coordinate with contractors, consultants, suppliers, and internal project teams to resolve technical and operational issues. Oversee electrical installations, including power distribution, lighting systems, low-current systems, and related infrastructure. Conduct site inspections and monitor the quality of electrical works to ensure compliance with applicable codes and safety requirements. Support testing, commissioning, inspections, and handover activities for completed electrical systems. Identify project risks, technical challenges, and potential delays, and recommend corrective actions. Prepare project progress reports, technical documentation, and updates for management. Ensure compliance with Saudi electrical regulations, relevant technical standards, and HSE requirements. Requirements Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related field. 3–5 years of relevant experience in electrical engineering, preferably within construction, real estate development, or facility projects. Strong knowledge of electrical systems, power distribution, lighting, and low-current systems. Experience reviewing electrical drawings, technical specifications, and construction documentation. Familiarity with Saudi Building Code (SBC), applicable IEC standards, and electrical safety requirements. Proficiency in AutoCAD and Microsoft Office. Knowledge of Revit MEP, MS Project, or Primavera P6 is an advantage. Strong technical problem-solving, communication, and project coordination skills. Ability to work effectively with contractors, consultants, and multidisciplinary project teams. Key Skills Electrical Project Engineering Electrical Systems Design & Installation Construction Project Coordination Power Distribution Systems Low Current Systems (ELV) Electrical Drawings & Shop Drawings Site Supervision & Inspections Testing & Commissioning Contractor & Consultant Management Project Planning & Scheduling AutoCAD / Revit MEP Quality Assurance & HSE Compliance

This role involves developing and delivering mechanical training programs for customer technicians, ensuring compliance with aviation regulations and company standards. The instructor will be responsible for creating comprehensive training materials and conducting practical on-the-job training. Develop course training standards, instructional plans, and synopses in accordance with customer regulations. 46b4e9f99451a0ed.description: About the Role Alshams Energy is seeking a Project Manager to lead aviation jet fuel infrastructure projects in Jiddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing projects from planning and execution through to handover, ensuring they are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in compliance with international aviation fuel standards. The scope of projects includes fuel farms, hydrant networks, pipelines, tank storage, pump stations, filtration systems, and associated control and safety systems. The Project Manager is accountable for the entire project lifecycle, from feasibility and design review to construction, commissioning, and operational takeover, while maintaining continuity of live airport fueling operations. Key Responsibilities Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and work breakdown structure in line with contract requirements. Develop and maintain integrated baseline schedules (Primavera P6 or MS Project), resource plans, and cash-flow forecasts. Lead execution of jet fuel infrastructure works, including fuel farm tanks, hydrant pits and loops, transfer pipelines, pump and filtration skids, and hydrant dispensers. Plan and coordinate tie-ins and shutdowns with airport operations to prevent disruption to aircraft fueling. Oversee testing, pre-commissioning, commissioning, and handover to operations, including punch-list closure. Review design packages, specifications, and vendor documents for compliance with project and client standards. Ensure systems comply with relevant international standards such as JIG 1, 2 and 4, EI 1529, EI 1540, EI/JIG 1530, API 650, API 2610, NFPA 407, and IATA fuel quality requirements. Coordinate with the Technical Director on technical queries, design changes, and deviations, and manage the Management of Change (MOC) process for modifications to existing fuel systems. Lead a zero-harm culture across all project activities and contractors, ensuring Permit-to-Work, Job Safety Analysis, isolation, hot work, and confined-space controls are applied on live fuel systems. Support HAZOP, HAZID, SIL, and risk assessment workshops, tracking actions to closure. Ensure environmental controls for spill prevention, soil and groundwater protection, and waste management, maintaining environmental baseline records. Comply with GACA regulations, client HSE requirements (including Saudi Aramco standards where applicable), and Saudi civil defense codes. Administer contracts with clients, EPC contractors, and subcontractors, including variations, claims, and notices. Control project budget, monitor earned value, and report cost and schedule variance with corrective actions. Support procurement of long-lead items such as pumps, filter-water separators, meters, valves, and tankage. Identify contract risks and discrepancies early, including insurance, bonding, and liability obligations, and escalate formally. Implement the project quality plan, inspection and test plans, and material traceability. Ensure welding, NDT, hydrotesting, internal tank coating, and pipeline cleanliness meet specification. Ensure fuel quality is protected through flushing, sampling, and certification before systems enter service. Act as the primary point of contact for the client on all project matters. Prepare and present weekly and monthly progress reports to senior management and client representatives. Coordinate with airport authorities, airlines, into-plane operators, and government entities. Lead, mentor, and evaluate the project team, promoting Saudization and knowledge transfer. Maintain project documentation, correspondence, and as-built records through the document control system. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in project management, preferably within aviation jet fuel infrastructure or a related heavy industry. Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects safely, on time, and within budget. Strong understanding of international aviation fuel standards and regulations. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jiddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role requires coordination with various stakeholders including airport operations, technical teams, contractors, and government entities, often in live operational environments. Application Process Candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply.
